title: Variable Output Get From List
description: Turn list.get into a variadic-output component: first output is i, + adds i+1, i+2, etc reading consecutive list elements from base index with wrap support.
summary: Turned list.get into a variadic-output component. Operator now registers variadic_output (min 1) and evaluates consecutive list elements as output keys 0..count-1 from base index with wrap support. Flow host stores output_ports on Neuron widgets, builds dynamic output labels i, i+1, ..., injects count into tree params, and exposes add_output_port/remove_output_port with wasm bindings. DAG gained side-aware DagPortSide pending insert, output-side + hit-test/painting at zoom>=1.5. React serializes outputPorts; play catalogue summary updated. Tests: list module 8/8, dag variadic 2/2, flow core add_output_port + 60/62 (2 pre-existing rectangle-extrude fixture failures), flow react 128/128.
